snippet.title: Pass the Fear | Steam Next Fest Gameplay Trailer 🎮 #roguelite #bullethell
snippet.description:
The New Demo Is OUT NOW!

🔥 Pass the Fear, the chaotic multiplayer co-op Roguelite bullet-hell shooter, is now part of Steam Next Fest!

🎮 A brand-new demo is now available, featuring the new character Elena, multiplayer lobbies, and a range of gameplay improvements for a refreshed experience.

Demon Hunters, gather your squad and jump in! ⚔️

🔥 Play the Demo NOW on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3561220

📝 If you run into any issues while playing, or have any thoughts you'd like to share, we'd love to hear from you!

🌐 Official Website:
https://paras.shengtian.com/fbpsd/en

💬 Join our Discord:
https://discord.gg/PKSA5FBMGg

📢 Follow us:
X/Twitter: https://x.com/PassTheFear
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/passthefear_official
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@passthefear
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@PasstheFear

#passthefear #roguelike #roguelite #bullethell #indiegame #gaming
